visual_elements.description: Legend confusion matrix: header 'Predicted as' spans columns P and N; row label 'Actual' spans rows P and N; cells are TP, FN in the P row and FP, TN in the N row.
Yellow rounded rectangle containing red text 'Threshold=0.1'.
Count confusion matrix: header 'Predicted as' over P and N; row label 'Actual' over P and N; cells: P row = 4 and 0, N row = 4 and 2. The 4 in the P/P cell is circled in red.

Left-to-right pipeline: 'Test Sample' label above a small white box containing an airplane icon; arrow to a red 'Model' box with a small graph icon and sublabel '[Any value] — (0, +1)'; arrow to a blue '(0 — 1)' box with 'Predicted Value' above it; arrow to a red 'Threshold (e.g 0.5)' box; two arrows branch right to a green 'Class I' box and a pink 'Class II' box.

Scatter/icon plot: red x-axis with tick labels 0.0, 0.5, and 1.0; blue dashed vertical threshold line near the 0.0 tick, intended to represent threshold=0.1; ten gray outline airplanes scattered as sample markers; most airplanes have a small red or blue dot; two right-side airplanes have black skull markings; rotated red text 'Predicted' appears along the left side.
Airplane icons: simple gray side-view airplanes used as sample markers; some have red dots, some blue dots, and two on the right have black skull icons.

imagery: Multiple simple gray airplane illustrations scattered across the lower plot as data markers.
A small airplane icon inside the 'Test Sample' box in the pipeline.

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. The title is bold, large, and dark red. Matrix headers and cell text are compact bold sans-serif. Flow-box text is white on colored fills. Axis tick labels are red. The left plot label 'Predicted' is rotated 90 degrees. No italic or serif text is visible.

recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background to white. 2. Add the title text box at the top-left: 'Effect of Selecting Threshold Value on Model Performance', bold sans-serif, about 28pt, color #C00000. 3. Add a yellow circle at the top-right containing '21' in black text. 4. In the top-left, draw the legend confusion matrix with red borders and white fill: a header row labeled 'Predicted as' over columns P and N, a left label 'Actual' over rows P and N, and cells TP/FN/FP/TN. 5. Add a yellow rounded rectangle to the right of that matrix containing red text 'Threshold=0.1'. 6. Below the legend matrix, draw the count confusion matrix with the same structure; set the P row to 4 and 0, and the N row to 4 and 2. Place a red oval outline around the 4 in the P/P cell. 7. Draw a beige rounded panel across the top-center/right. Inside it, place 'Test Sample' above a small white box with a gray airplane icon, then an arrow to a red rounded box labeled 'Model' in white text; under the Model box add red text '[Any value] — (0, +1)'. 8. Continue the flow with an arrow to a blue rounded box labeled '(0 — 1)' in white text; place red text 'Predicted Value' above that box. 9. Add an arrow to a red rounded box labeled 'Threshold (e.g 0.5)' in white text. 10. From the threshold box, draw two arrows to the right: one to a green rounded box labeled 'Class I' and one to a pink rounded box labeled 'Class II'. 11. Draw the main plot as a white rectangle with a red border in the lower area. Add a red horizontal x-axis with ticks and labels at 0.0, 0.5, and 1.0. Add rotated red text 'Predicted' along the left side. Add a blue dashed vertical line near the 0.0 tick to represent threshold=0.1. 12. Scatter about ten gray outline airplane icons across the plot at approximate percentage positions: (12,78) red dot, (16,58) blue dot, (20,38) red dot, (36,82) blue dot, (33,60) red dot, (30,42) blue dot, (82,86) blue dot, (66,62) red dot with skull, (45,22) blue dot, and (78,34) skull marking. Use small red or blue dots on the airplanes and black skull icons where noted.
